title: [Radio’ Clock] Tea Time Thursday with Kim So Yeon 김소연
description:
말 하는걸 그대로 받아 적는 것도 어려운데,
번역까지 해서 말하는 속도로 와다다- 써내려가는
번역하는 속도에 타자 치는 속도까지 엄청난 능력자!
ASC의 번역을 맡아서 오랜시간 해온 김소연 영어 번역 작가님과 함께 했습니다!

처음엔 긴장했지만, 점점 긴장이 풀리고
솔직하고 정말 재미있는 모습들 많이 보여주고 가셨는데요!
춤도 춰주고, 재미있는 포-즈까지 취해서 사진찍고 가준
능력도 재미도 입담도 뛰어난 김소연 작가님과의 재미있는 수다! 함께 하세요!

It is difficult to write down what is being said as it is, but she even translates it and types it out as the speed of speech- English Writer Kim So-yeon.
We met Soyeon Kim, an English translator who has been an English writer of ASC for a long time!
So-yeon was a person with tremendous talent in live translating!

She was nervous at first, but then after feeling a bit more relaxed, she showed a lot of honest and fun sides!
A great chat with writer Kim So-yeon, who in the end danced and even did funny poses for the pictures, was talented, fun, and witty! Join us once again through the video!
